headline: Paramount settles states' antitrust suit, clearing its Warner Bros. merger
summary: Paramount settled the antitrust lawsuit brought by California and other states over its $110 billion Warner Bros. Discovery acquisition, clearing a major roadblock for the merger to proceed.

claims.statement: Paramount settled the antitrust lawsuit over its $110 billion Warner Bros. Discovery acquisition.

sources.quote: Paramount has reached a settlement with California and the 11 other states that sued to block its planned $110 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery.
Paramount settles US states' antitrust lawsuit, clearing the way for its Warner Bros. acquisition

claims.statement: The settlement clears the way for the merger to proceed.

sources.quote: The settlement removes a major roadblock standing in the way of the massive media merger.
The mega-merger of the year will apparently go forward.
